description: Source file implementing unary operations and utilities for nested tensors in PyTorch, including definitions of tensor operations like abs, sgn, relu, tanh, and functions for nested tensor manipulation.

methods.name: NestedTensor_abs_
methods.description: In-place absolute value operation on a nested tensor buffer.

methods.name: NestedTensor_where
methods.description: Performs a conditional selection on nested tensors, returning a new nested tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_where_out
methods.description: Performs a conditional selection on nested tensors, writing the result into an existing nested tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_sgn_
methods.description: In-place sign operation on a nested tensor buffer.

methods.name: NestedTensor_logical_not_
methods.description: In-place logical NOT operation on a nested tensor buffer.

methods.name: NestedTensor_relu_
methods.description: In-place ReLU operation on a nested tensor buffer.

methods.name: NestedTensor_gelu_
methods.description: In-place GELU activation on a nested tensor buffer.

methods.name: NestedTensor_gelu
methods.description: Applies GELU activation to a nested tensor, returning a new nested tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_tanh_
methods.description: In-place hyperbolic tangent activation on a nested tensor buffer.

methods.name: NestedTensor_neg_
methods.description: In-place negation of a nested tensor buffer.

methods.name: zero_nested_
methods.description: Fills the nested tensor buffer with zeros.

methods.name: NestedTensor_silu_
methods.description: In-place SiLU activation on a nested tensor buffer.

methods.name: _pin_memory_nested
methods.description: Pins memory for a nested tensor, preparing it for transfer to GPU.
